title: Membaca Data dan Sintesis Informasi
summary: Multi-source multimodal synthesis: integrating complex statistical infographics, academic bar/scatter charts, and research abstracts to form coherent syntheses and predictions.

lessons.title: Synthesizing Prose with Multimodal Data Displays

blocks.html: Synthesizing Prose with Multimodal Data Displays: Cross-verifying tabular demographics, scatterplots, and flow diagrams against text narrative.

blocks.title: Fokus Konsep
blocks.html: Dual-code reading strategies for complex scientific reports.

blocks.title: Contoh soal data
blocks.question: A chart shows a city's bus passengers: 2022 = 1.2 million, 2023 = 1.5 million, 2024 = 1.8 million. By how much did passengers increase from 2022 to 2024?
steps: by menanyakan besar kenaikan, bukan nilai akhir.

blocks.question: Text A (a ministry report) says a new app reduced waiting times at health centres. Text B (a survey of 50 patients at one centre) says many older patients found the app difficult. Which statement is the best synthesis?

options.B: The app may reduce waiting times, but some users, such as older patients, need support.
options.C: Text B proves the ministry report is false.
options.D: Older patients do not visit health centres.

blocks.explanation: Sintesis yang tepat memakai kedua sumber: manfaat dari laporan resmi dan kendala dari survei. Survei kecil tidak membuktikan laporan itu salah.

blocks.title: Membaca data dan mensintesis dua sumber
blocks.caption: Tentukan apakah pernyataan didukung, dibantah, atau tidak disebut data. Set kedua melatih mengenali informasi dari dua sumber.

blocks.title: Contoh sintesis
blocks.question: Text A (government): the free school meal programme reached 3 million students in its first year. Text B (teacher's blog): at her school, meals sometimes arrive late, but attendance has improved. What can be concluded from both texts?
steps: Text B: pengalaman satu sekolah, ada kendala dan manfaat.
Simpulan yang aman: program menjangkau banyak siswa dan tampak bermanfaat, tetapi pelaksanaannya masih punya kendala. Text B tidak bisa digeneralisasi ke semua sekolah.
blocks.answer: The programme reaches many students and may bring benefits, but there are practical problems in some places

lessons.title: Cross-Synthesizing Two Academic Studies with Divergent Findings

blocks.html:
Cross-Synthesizing Two Academic Studies with Divergent Findings: Synthesizing conflicting research findings by identifying differing methodologies or population samples.

Pelajari konsep melalui representasi visual dan simulasi interaktif di bawah ini untuk memperkuat pemahaman intuisi dan pembuktian prinsip dasar.

blocks.title: Pertanyaan sintesis yang sering muncul
blocks.html:
• What information does Text B provide that Text A does not?
  • Which conclusions can be drawn by combining both texts?
  • Why should readers be careful about generalizing Text B? (ukuran sampel, satu wilayah, satu narasumber)
  • Why is Text B useful even though ...? (perspektif pengguna, praktik nyata)

blocks.title: Supported, contradicted, not mentioned
blocks.html: Supported: data atau teks menunjukkannya. Contradicted: data atau teks menunjukkan sebaliknya. Not mentioned: informasinya tidak ada, walaupun mungkin benar di dunia nyata. Jangan memakai pengetahuan di luar teks.
